q: OAuth 2.0 on its own is for …
why: OpenID Connect adds the ID token for login.

q: PKCE protects the authorization code flow against …
why: Only the app that made the verifier can redeem the code.

o: the credential is bound to the site's origin
why: A fake site cannot get a valid signature.

q: SMS codes are as strong as an authenticator app (TOTP).
why: Myth. SMS can be hijacked by SIM swapping and interception.
